entry_points.text: Fault waits for punch and returns cached folio as NOPAGE/RETRY/LOCKED; mmap picks ops by link; open sets FMODE_CAN_ODIRECT; lockless read revalidates with zero holes; write is exclusive; SEEK_DATA/HOLE locates.

Create checks name, allocates inode, sets ACL/security, registers offset and grows parent in fixed units with version bump; tmpfile attaches; mkdir bumps links; link adds offset; unlink/rmdir remove and shrink; whiteout makes char node.
Link lookup has lock-free and sleeping paths rejecting bad storage; put drops ref; fileattr exposes user subset and merges bits; xattr resolves qualified names on per-inode list.
Export compares generation plus split 64-bit number; encode needs three words with generation/low/high and lazy hash under static lock; decode validates and returns alias; parent always stale.

Remount under stat lock rejects caps when unlimited or overused, commits huge, width, caps, policy and noswap, dropping old policy after unlock; show reports non-defaults, width when wide, huge, policy, swap and quota.

Fill allocates info with defaults, records noswap, inits locks, UUID and root; info holds caps, free space, owner, mode, width, huge, policy, quota and shrink; put releases all; context sets sticky mode; init creates cache and mounts.
Global huge shows modes bracketed active; store parses short token, updates global and internal above deny and restarts collapse; error removal always succeeds.

exports.text: Gets generic address then optionally aligns for huge use; skips when huge off, MAP_FIXED pinned, hint ok or small; reserves larger span, always falls back; prefers shared and private until COW; anon derives unit from small-huge order.
Tracks SHMEM_F_LOCKED flag; first lock charges whole size and marks unevictable, first unlock uncharges and clears with context; repeats succeed free.

hazards.text: Poison fails as I/O error with single-page fallback; bad link, overlong, bad flags, non-empty victim and exhausted space fail; stack queue may invalidate waiter pointer, completion avoids dereference; creation funnels through teardown, huge store rejects overlong.

invariants.text: Policy uses inode object, biasing interleave by inode number with linear index; xattr init null in one build, in other reserves inode space under stat lock with refund.

Fill rejects past rounded end, allocates order-zero with SGP_CACHE/READ/WRITE/NOALLOC/FALLOC, abandoning on charge fail; insert locks, marks swap-backed, caches with rollback and tracks reclaim; remove un-caches.

Write begin rejects F_SEAL_GROW/WRITE/FUTURE_WRITE and SHMEM_F_MAPPING_FROZEN, fails on poison; write end extends and clears gaps; splice caps by pipe, resolves folio or hole and splices folio or zero page.

Punch publishes wait, unmaps and discards; alloc checks frozen, seals, overflow and budget, extends and clears private under lock; statfs gives type, page blocks, caps when limited and UUID; modes FALLOC_FL_KEEP_SIZE/PUNCH_HOLE; errors ENOMEM EPERM EOPNOTSUPP EFBIG EINTR ENXIO EIO EFAULT EINVAL ENOSPC.

Mount parses size, blocks, inodes, mode, ids, huge, policy, width, noswap and quota with guards; comma ends option only before non-digit; quota rejects trailing, zero and ceiling; casefold loads map or fails.
Width shrink rejected when next id exceeds narrow range; noswap is one-way; remount quota activation rejected when none loaded; quota limit changes rejected.

locks.text: Inode spin guards coordination pointer and queue with start, next and counters; holders install or clear under lock; fault inside interval sleeps TASK_UNINTERRUPTIBLE until wake, retrying if protection released.
Dedicated spin guards per-order huge prefs while moving one order bit into selected set and clearing others, reporting change.

state_machines.text: Rename checks flags, delegates exchange, requires empty target, acquires offset, optionally whiteouts with rollback, moves offsets, repairs links, transfers size and updates times.
Symlink bounds length with terminator by one page, short duplicates with cached ops while longer use page folio filled and dirtied; failures remove offset.
Per-size has five modes with at most one owning an order; display brackets first owner else never; store resolves token then exclusively reassigns order.

structs.text: Userfault table has five callbacks for permission, lookup, allocation, insertion and removal; permission always allows and lookup propagates errors.
Zero pipe acquire always succeeds, release is no-op and steal always declines, preventing capture of zero page.

Symlink tables differ only in resolver; export binds parent, encode and decode; xattr binds three prefixes to shared get and set; mount binds names to enum, huge strings never, always, within_size and advise to constants and typed forms.
Context binds release and nodev build; address, file, inode, dir, special, super and VM tables wire IO, faults, policy and userfault; dentry delegates folding hash and compare.
Inodes come from dedicated cache with once init, alloc may fail null, release frees link target, destroy drops policy or directory state, cache uses panic and accounting.
Filesystem is tmpfs with TMPFS_MAGIC, page blocks, max size ceiling, unit granularity and donotcache root; sysfs uses standard perm helpers, features group and fixed casefold marker.
External VFS, security, locking, math, percpu, credential, string, sysfs and parser helpers for shmem directory, xattr, export, fault and mount paths; owned elsewhere.
